Docking.help: DOCK: request clearance through Comms, select that target, finish/stop any Fly approach, then select Dock here or use phobosnav dock. Start within 10 km of the hull with room to brake. RCS only, up to 20 m/s; native throttle applies. Final clamps require this navigation console to be open. Reload suspends docking for explicit Resume and fresh clearance/port checks. Stop removes thrust, not velocity. No obstacle avoidance, mooring, undocking or atmospheric landing.

Instruments.help:
PROPULSION
AUTO prefers a usable running torch where permitted, with RCS fallback. RCS inhibits Auto Nav torch burns. This dial does not ignite the reactor.

DIALS
Click the left/right half, use the wheel, or drag up/down. Focused arrow keys also step. Amber values mean locked settings; Details remains available.

STOP / COAST
Ends guidance and removes commanded thrust. It does not brake.

Use phobosnav arrival <km> for exact custom distances. No docking, obstacle avoidance or station keeping.

Overlay.PhobosNavModAutoNav.description: An aftermarket module for a Polaris navigation station. Torch-preferred approach and braking with RCS fallback and native no-wake protection, including below 5,000 km, with adjustable stopping distance and hull clearance. Repair and Restore for reuse, or dismantle into retained board residue. Docking requires a separate Dock action and native clearance. Does not avoid obstacles or hold position.
Overlay.PhobosNavModAutoNav.name: Polaris Auto Nav Module
Overlay.PhobosNavModAutoNavDmg.descripti: A damaged Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module. Repair with two small electronic parts, then Restore its remaining wear before use. Fits a Polaris navigation station. Dismantling retains 0.4 kg of board residue.
Overlay.PhobosNavModAutoNavDmg.name: Polaris Auto Nav Module (Damaged)
Plugin.abort_on_larger_simulation_update: Abort on larger simulation updates; avoids commanding a long unobserved burn.
Plugin.adaptation_of_auto_navigate_by_gr: Adaptation of Auto Navigate by Gravy/mrkmg. F3: phobosnav help. Ordinary saves supported; Phobos Framework required; no upstream mod dependency.
Plugin.allowed_speed_error_at_arrival_no: Allowed speed error at arrival; not a station-keeping guarantee.
Plugin.arrival_relative_speed_zero_reque: Arrival speed seed for consoles without saved preferences (m/s). Zero requests matching target motion. Adjust in Details or with phobosnav arrivalspeed.
Plugin.centre_to_centre_arrival_distance: Starting stopping distance for consoles without saved preferences, in km (not minimum engagement range); larger hulls require extra clearance. New configurations default to 1 km. F3: phobosnav arrival <km> saves this console's default; phobosnav fly <km> overrides one flight.
Plugin.check_the_inherited_approximate_d: Check the conservative RCS fallback delta-v budget before departure, even with torch preference; not a fuel guarantee.
Plugin.cruise_speed_relative_to_target_c: Cruise speed seed for consoles without saved preferences (m/s relative to target). Adjust each console in Details or with phobosnav cruise. Captured on engagement.
Plugin.legacy_guidance_check_phobos_alwa: Legacy guidance check. Phobos always yields to external maneuver commands regardless of this value.
Plugin.master_switch_switching_off_abort: Master switch; switching off aborts an active flight.
Plugin.use_rcs_turning_false_retains_ups: Use RCS turning. False retains upstream's instantaneous heading change for comparisons.
Plugin.velocity_error_before_a_cruise_co: Minimum cruise velocity-error band in m/s. The resume threshold is the greater of this and CoastSpeedTolerancePercent of cruise speed. Sideways drift and braking can demand correction sooner. Captured on engagement.
Plugin.coast_speed_tolerance_percent: Cruise velocity-error band as a percentage of requested cruise speed. Higher values favour coasting. Added alongside existing CoastToleranceMS; does not relax arrival speed or braking. Captured on engagement.
Plugin.coast_enter_fraction: Fraction of the resume threshold at which a cruise correction stops and coasting begins (0.75 means 75%). The higher resume threshold prevents rapid switching. Captured on engagement.
Plugin.burn_heading_tolerance_degrees: Heading deadband in degrees while making a course correction. During coasting, do not chase target heading; only damp significant spin. Captured on engagement.
NavigationService.coast_settings: Coasting ({6}): resume at max({0} m/s, {1}% of cruise); stop correcting at {2}% of that band. Burn heading tolerance {3} degrees. Sideways drift guard: {5}% of arrival radius over {4} s. Braking takes priority.
Recipe.PhobosBuildAutoNav.description: Assemble and calibrate a 0.4 kg Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module for a Polaris navigation station from 1 kg of electronics; retain 0.6 kg of offcuts. Docking requires a separate Dock action and native clearance. Does not avoid obstacles.
Recipe.PhobosBuildAutoNav.name: Polaris Auto Nav Module

Sensors.help: Fly, Dock and Resume require live native sensing. Weak or lost contact suspends guidance and clears Auto Nav thrust; it does not brake blindly or resume automatically when the signal returns. Destination and progress are retained. Radar and LiDAR are never enabled automatically. Range and speed are unknown without a usable track. Sensor Operations skill uses the currently selected crew member aboard this ship, including with the panel closed.
